bug_info.bug_desc: In debug mode, the DRET branch unconditionally clears `illegal_instr`. This overwrites the earlier reserved-field checks, so malformed DRET encodings with nonzero rd or rs1 can execute as valid debug returns.
bug_info.fix_hint: Keep the existing `illegal_instr` value when debug mode permits DRET, and only force the instruction illegal when the hart is outside debug mode.
